environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a VPC with default security group allowing all outbound traffic. Task IAM role has S3 and DynamoDB access. Container runs with default networking - full egress to 169.254.170.2 (ECS credential endpoint) and 169.254.169.254 (EC2 metadata). Service is exposed via ALB on port 443 with no request filtering rules. No network ACLs restricting link-local traffic from task ENI.

config.networking: awsvpc mode, default SG, all egress allowed
config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener, no WAF attached
